# ConveyorDemo - data types, AOIs and tags

## User-defined data types

### UDT_Alarms

Alarm bits for the line; tag-based alarm conditions are attached to the members (alarms.json)

| Member | Type | Dim | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conveyor01_Fault | BOOL |  | Conveyor 01 run feedback missing |
| EStopActive | BOOL |  | Emergency stop circuit open |
| SimModeActive | BOOL |  | Simulation mode is active |
| Spare | DINT |  | Spare for future alarm bits |

### UDT_Motor

HMI interface for a single-direction motor: commands, status and configuration

| Member | Type | Dim | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cmd_Start | BOOL |  | HMI start command (momentary, cleared by PLC) |
| Cmd_Stop | BOOL |  | HMI stop command (momentary, cleared by PLC) |
| Cmd_Reset | BOOL |  | HMI fault reset (momentary, cleared by PLC) |
| Sts_Run | BOOL |  | Motor is commanded to run |
| Sts_Fault | BOOL |  | Motor fault latched (feedback missing) |
| Sts_Ready | BOOL |  | Motor is ready to start (no fault, safety OK) |
| Cfg_FaultDelay_ms | DINT |  | Feedback fault delay in milliseconds |
| Sts_RunHours | REAL |  | Accumulated run hours |

## Add-On Instructions

### AOI_Motor (rev 1.0)

Single-direction motor with seal-in start/stop, run-feedback supervision and latched fault.

| Parameter | Usage | Type | Req | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Start | Input | BOOL | yes | Start command (level or pulse) |
| Stop | Input | BOOL | yes | Stop command, 1 = stop (drops seal-in) |
| Feedback | Input | BOOL | yes | Run feedback (contactor aux / drive running) |
| Reset | Input | BOOL | yes | Fault reset |
| FaultDelay | Input | DINT |  | Feedback supervision delay (ms) |
| Run | Output | BOOL | yes | Run output to contactor/drive |
| Fault | Output | BOOL | yes | Latched feedback fault |

## Controller tags

| Tag | Type | Dim | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HMI_Conveyor01 | UDT_Motor |  | Read/Write | HMI interface for conveyor 01 |
| Alarms | UDT_Alarms |  | Read/Write | Line alarm bits (tag-based alarm conditions attached) |
| Sys_HeartBeat | BOOL |  | Read/Write | 1 Hz heartbeat for HMI watchdog |
| Sys_FirstScan | BOOL |  | Read/Write | True for the first scan after power-up/download |
| Sys_AlarmAck | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Global alarm acknowledge from HMI |
| Sim_Mode | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Simulation mode: feedback simulated, physical outputs blocked |
| I_PB_Start | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Local start pushbutton (NO). TODO: alias_for Local:2:I.Data.0 once I/O module XML is added |
| I_PB_Stop | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Local stop pushbutton (NC, 1 = healthy). TODO: alias_for Local:2:I.Data.1 |
| I_ESTOP_OK | BOOL |  | Read/Write | E-stop circuit healthy from safety relay. TODO: alias_for Local:2:I.Data.2 |
| I_Conveyor01_Aux | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Conveyor 01 contactor auxiliary contact. TODO: alias_for Local:2:I.Data.3 |
| O_Conveyor01_Run | BOOL |  | Read/Write | Conveyor 01 contactor coil. TODO: alias_for Local:3:O.Data.0 |

## Program tags: P_Conveyor

| Tag | Type | Dim | Usage | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Conveyor01 | AOI_Motor |  |  | Conveyor 01 motor control instance |
| PB_Start | BOOL |  |  | Mapped start pushbutton |
| PB_Stop_OK | BOOL |  |  | Mapped stop pushbutton, 1 = not pressed |
| ESTOP_OK | BOOL |  |  | Mapped E-stop healthy |
| Conveyor01_Start | BOOL |  |  | Combined start request |
| Conveyor01_Stop | BOOL |  |  | Combined stop request |
| Alarm_Any | BOOL |  |  | Any alarm active (HMI banner) |
| T_HeartBeat | TIMER |  |  | Heartbeat toggle timer |
| T_RunHours | TIMER |  |  | Run-hour accumulator (1 h preset) |
| T_SimAux | TIMER |  |  | Simulated contactor aux delay |
